lines.text: Your cabinet painting price is simple. Count the openings, and multiply by one hundred twenty-five dollars.
Homeowners are finally getting cabinet pricing that actually makes sense, because at Work Horse Pro Painting, we made the process simple, predictable, and totally upfront.
If you want to know what it will cost to repaint your cabinets, just count the openings, and multiply by one hundred twenty-five dollars.
No guessing. No inflated quotes. No confusing breakdowns. Your price is clear before we even walk in the door.

This special covers everything from start to finish, including full prep, sanding, degreasing, priming, and a premium finish that makes your cabinets look brand new, without spending thousands of dollars on replacements.

With over thirty years of experience serving homeowners in New Hampshire, Massachusetts, and Maine, and a motto that says it all, let our family treat you like family, you'll get clean, precise results you'll actually love walking into.
And every cabinet project comes with a one-year craftsmanship warranty, so your investment is protected long after we leave.
If you want a clean, modern look without a massive renovation, this is the smartest way to do it.
